name: Flow-Field Ribbons
desc: Long silky streamlines traced through an evolving Perlin flow field and drawn as translucent tapering ribbons that braid and layer into a wind-swept, sunset-lit fabric, forever reseeding as the field rotates and scrolls.

speed.doc: field drift + scroll + integration step rate

warp.doc: field turbulence / how tightly ribbons coil

braid.doc: lateral interleave — how much neighbours weave
